programme.title: Let Our Angel Live
programme.desc: The Angels and Bosley are hired to track down Joe Danworth, who walked off with $200,000 of his employer's money. Kelly and Bosley are waiting in their cars outside of his apartment building when he shows up.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels (Pilot)
programme.desc: Three sexy police-trained detectives work for an unseen boss named, Charlie, who always relays his assignments by telephone.

programme.title: Hellride
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels, three bright, beautiful, athletic and police-trained private detectives become involved in a whirlwind of danger when they invest-igate the death of a woman stock car racer in the premiere episode of the new detective-drama series, Charlie's Angels. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and-Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant. In Hellride, Sabrina becomes a race driver while Kelly, Jill and Bosley assume unusual disguises to learn why a pretty woman driver lost control of her car and died in a flaming wreck.

programme.title: The Mexican Connection
programme.desc: Jill, Kelly and Sabrina find themselves in the middle of a syndicate heroin war as The Mexican Connection airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. Charlie assigns the girls to find the saboteurs of a charter plane carrying cache of heroin. They travel south of the border to Mexico; their mission known only to the lone-surviving pilot of the ill-fated flight. Before they can sake their false identities credible, Charlie's Angels find themselves caught be-tween two warring heroin dealers. Finally, they are able to maneuver one of the drug kingpins into a federal police trap -- only to discover that the other one was working with them all along, under a false identity of his own! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smyth star as the Angels Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Night of the Strangler
programme.desc: Kelly is a dead-ringer for a famous (murdered) photographer's model Night of the Strangler on Charlie's Angels. A series of rag doll stranglings brings Charlie's Angels (Kelly, Jill and Sabrina) into the case. Charlie counts on Kelly's resemblance to the first murdered girl to attract the killer. The wife of a well-known fashion designer is the next victim. Narrowing the possibilities, Charlie's Angels date the three most suspect men -- knowing full well one of them is a killer of great ingenuity and imagination. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels in Chains
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as Angels in Chains airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a kangaroo court to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an early release and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Target: Angels
programme.desc: Multiple attempts to kill Kelly, Jill and Sabrina force them to flee to the safety of Charlie's mansion in Target Angels on the new series Charlie's Angels. In separate incidents, an unknown assassin tries to kill Angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina. The pressure intensifies, forcing the girls to take to the only sure safety they know the compound where Charlie lives. Their anticipation at the prospect of seeing Charlie for the first time dims when they suddenly realize they have led the killers to their real target - Charlie! Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Killing Kind
programme.desc: Charlie calls angels Jill, Kelly and Sabrina together and tells them of the murder of the daughter of an old friend -- a young investigative reporter. In their quest to solve the killing, the three (Jill posing as a magazine photographer, Sabrina as a tennis instructor and Kelly as a guest) penetrate an exclusive hotel-resort. They soon learn that the owner, an underworld figure who, after turn-ing state's evidence and getting a new identity as part of the government's witness relocation program, has built a new criminal empire for himself. Their second discovery is that he intends to kill them. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Lady Killer
programme.desc: A sexploitation empire is threatened when its nude centerfold models are mysteriously murdered in Lady Killer, on Charlie's Angels.

programme.title: Bullseye
programme.desc: Two Army officers profiting from drug purchases murder in order to protect their scheme as Bullseye airs on Charlie's Angels. A recruit in the Women's Army Corps is shot to death on the firing range and Charlie's Angels are assigned to investigate. Bosley works undercover as a civilian researcher with Sabrina as an Array nurse and Jill and Kelly as new enlistees. A military physician and a cruel drill instructor are discovered to be purchasing large quantities of cheap, inactive drugs and reselling them to the Army at top quality retail prices. Unfortunately, before the Angels can complete their investigation, they become the targets of a search--and-destroy mission. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Consenting Adults
programme.desc: A computer dating service, fronting for prostitutes and their robber accomplices, starts an underworld war by stealing hot diamonds from a syndicate courier in The Consenting Adults on Charlie's Angels. A prostitute supplied by a computer dating service keeps an antique dealer preoccupied while his store is burglarized of priceless art objects. One of the stolen items is a ceramic frog, stuffed with smuggled diamonds -- belonging to a ruthless crime syndicate boss. Thinking he is lying about the thefts, the enraged kingpin kidnaps the antique dealers and Charlie's Angels enter the case. Jill infiltrates the dating service posing as a hooker but finds that the prostitute involved in the burglary has led the crime boss to the diamonds. In a last ditch effort to gain evidence, Angels Sabrina and Jill disguise themselves as veterinarians and steal the syndicate chieftain's championship racehorse. The chieftain agrees to meet the Angels in a park and turn over the diamonds in exchange for his horse. In the exciting climax, Angel Jill must make a getaway with the evidence on her skateboard -- chased by a syndicate hit man Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Seance
programme.desc: Rich widows and widowers are hypnotized into thinking their deceased spouses still manage their business affairs from the 'other side' as The Seance airs on Charlie's Angels. A spirited dowager, pressured by insurance investigators about the repeated disappearances of her jewelry, hires Charlie's Angels to solve the mystery. The girls get their first clue when the daffy old lady tells them that her dead husband manages her business affairs from the grave through a medium named Madame Dorian. Kelly assumes the identity of a rich Texas widow; Jill becomes her friend from the 'Lone Star' state and Bosley, their French chauffeur. Unbeknownst to the others, Madame Dorian's male assistant hypnotizes Kelly as he had done with previous widows -- to get financial information from her. During the trance, she reveals her true identity as a private investigator. Realizing that the con game has been uncovered, he programs Kelly to perceive Jill as a childhood bogeyperson, so he can attempt a getaway. The hypnotized Kelly helps in his escape by keeping Charlie's team busy trying to stop her from killing Jill. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angels on Wheels
programme.desc: Jill becomes the hated star of a roller derby team when she goes undercover to investigate the mysterious death of a beautiful skater as Death on Wheels airs (day/date/time) on Channel 's Charlie's Angels. Skating champ Karen Jason is killed after being forced over the guardrail and into the audience during a rough and tumble race. Charlie's client believes Karen was murdered, despite the police report stating that the death was accidental. In search of clues, Sabrina poses as a state insurance investigator, Kelly as a pushy writer for a national magazine and Jill as a member of the roller derby team. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina Duncan, Jill Munroe and Kelly Garrett, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Angel Trap
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels are summoned to try and stop an assassin intent on killing the members of an old French Underground team in Angel Trap on Charlie's Angels. Fernando Lamas guest stars as Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man with a record of assassination dating back to the days of the World War II French Underground. He becomes the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed. From one of Jericho's ex-girlfriends, Charlie's Angels learn chat he intends to eliminate all of the members of his old French Underground team. In an attempt to capture Jericho before he can carry out his plans, Sabrina poses as the girlfriend of Kamden, the' next likely victim of the team, and Jill sets up an accidental meeting with Jericho. Jill soon finds it difficult to keep her mind on the job as she becomes emotionally involved with the romantic killer. She and Sabrina guess that the probable time and place of Jericho's next move will be in the city park. There, Kelly and an army of police await the inevitable. Jericho arrives in their midst, smiling confidently, carrying his pet kitten. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: The Big Tap Out
programme.desc: Sabrina, Jill and Kelly con a compulsive gambler out of his money in order to trap him in his usual burglary method of replenishing his gambling stakes in The Big Tap Out, on Charlie's Angels. When notorious gambler-thief, Roy David is suspected of burglarizing a securities company of $40,000 to replenish his gambling money, Charlie's Angels are called into the case to obtain the necessary evidence to convict him of the crime. Sabrina and Bosley dupe the gambler into betting nearly half of the loot on a losing horse at the race track. Jill then takes over the scheme at the gambling tables to cheat him out of his remaining money. With David penniless and in desperate need of renewed gambling stakes, the Angels make it easy for him to follow his usual burglary pattern. In front of startled eyes, they carefully, stage a hit-and-run accident in which Jill is apparently killed with detailed floor plans and safe combinations to the casino in her possession. David, of course, steals the plans and immediately sets up a burglary. When David tries to make his getaway from the casino with the stolen money, Kelly stops his escape by ramming her car into the back of his, thereby causing a great commotion into which the police are summoned. On the scene, police discover the cache of stolen money inside David's car, and his gambling days are over. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: To Kill An angel
programme.desc: The entire political and law enforcement, hierarchy of a rural town is involved in an extortion-murder scheme which preys on wealthy, young women as Angels in Chains airs on the new series, Charlie's Angels. The half-sister of a missing girl prompts a Charlie's Angels investigation of a country prison farm and a nearby small town sheriff. Kelly and Jill deliberately get arrested for speeding. They are sentenced by a kangaroo court to unusually long terms at the nearby prison-farm. Once there, they discover that the sheriff, prison authorities, and the local County Manager are partners in an extortion-murder scheme. Wealthy young women without relatives are arrested and jailed on trumped-up violations. The women are virtually enslaved until they sign over all their assets in exchange for an early release and then killed. Those inquiring further are told that the missing girls have been paroled. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Lady Killer
programme.desc: A sexploitation empire is threatened when its nude centerfold models are mysteriously murdered in Lady Killer, on Charlie's Angels.

programme.title: Bullseye
programme.desc: Two Army officers profiting from drug purchases murder in order to protect their scheme as Bullseye airs on Charlie's Angels. A recruit in the Women's Army Corps is shot to death on the firing range and Charlie's Angels are assigned to investigate. Bosley works undercover as a civilian researcher with Sabrina as an Array nurse and Jill and Kelly as new enlistees. A military physician and a cruel drill instructor are discovered to be purchasing large quantities of cheap, inactive drugs and reselling them to the Army at top quality retail prices. Unfortunately, before the Angels can complete their investigation, they become the targets of a search--and-destroy mission. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ten of the world’s strongest men gathered in Amman to compete in Jordan’s first-ever Truck-Pull Championship. The contestants race against the clock while pulling a 21-ton truck across the track. One of the most fierce competitors to take part in the event was four-time winner of the World’s Strongest Man competition, Brian Shaw.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Taking place in Corinth, Greece, considered by many the cradle of the sports competition games, an epic strongman battle will mark the last stage before the upcoming big two-day season’s finale in Chetumal, Mexico. In front of more than 5000 spectators, the twelve athletes compete in Log Lifts, Card Deadlift, Conan’s Wheel and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first day of the two-part finale sees the strongest men competing in Carry and Drag, Dumbbell Lift and the Truck Pull. Everything is possible in this heated fight for the crown against the backdrop of stunning Chetumal, Mexico.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the second day of the grand finale of the 2017 Strongman Champions League, the athletes have a last chance to secure the medals in the spectacular four events Weight for Height, Deadlift Cars, Forward Hold and The Loading Medley. Be prepared for stunning performances – and even world records!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Season 2018 begins with 14 strongest men in the world, all competing for the title. The competition kicks off in Norway. We’ll see typical Viking disciplines, team events and world records in heavy conditions in the land of snow and ice. They will suffer, they will freeze and fight in this first competition of the year for the title that they will carry on their shoulders throughout whole year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capichampions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2018 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time in history, Strongman Champions League will set up competition in Abu Dhabi. The line-up of super athletes, who are part of the SCL, includes former world champions Dainis Zageris (Latvia) And Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland), current world champion Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and biggest strongman in the World Sean O’Hagan (Ireland).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman classic in land where there is no place for anything else excepts strength, fight and endurance. Here are fourteen of the strongest men, fighting for the title of strongest in Holland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We go back to Holland, where former champion Dainis Zageris is in leading position after the first three events. Alongside Radzikowski, he is in this moment favorite for world title, and also leader shirt holder.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage six of Strongman champions league, 2018 is set back on north, in Finland. Here we have Matjaz Belsak, wearing SCL leader shirt, one of the biggest strongman in the World Mika Torro, fan favorite strongman in all over the World – Will Baggott, and also big name from Baltic – Aivars Smaukstelis

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Twelve strongman, including defending Worldchampion Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia , will compete on “Air spa” for the title of best in homeland country of Tesla, Pupin, Novak Djokovic. Matjaz Belsak is the SCL leader in this competition, chasing his third victory this season.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The World championship in lightweights of the Strongman Champions League bring to us 50 strongmen from all over the world. All athletes are under 105 kilograms and for them this is the step up to the ultimate heavyweights.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this second stage of the World championship of lightweights we will find out who out of the 12 athletes will win the title in the under 105 kilogram category.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of SCL Romania 2018 will be hosted in Brasov. This episode features a new event for Strongman Champion League: “ The Chopper Pull”!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three classical Strongman events – Dead lift, Loading and Front hold – and one historical, Chopper Pull for the first time in history of Strongman, now we go to find out who will take title in Romania. This is the second stage in Romania and it remains to be seen who will win the title; Aivars, Travis or Krzyzstof?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next destination of Strongman Champions League is in a piece of paradise on earth – Curacao. We bring to you some special Strongman events like the Rock Lift, Tug of War and Weight for Height in this episode.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This is the last competition before the grand finals. After the first three events Zageris is in top place, but can O’Hagan, Baggott, Petursson and Ortmayer step into the final? Last chance some of them will find through events like Forward Hold, Truck Pull, Dead Lift and loading very big objects.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We bring you 50 minutes of Strongman inside. Fears, inspiration, courage, the best and worst from our finalists and their expectation of the finals. We also go to Poland and Germany to represent one day in the training of Krzysztof Radzikowski and Dennis Kohlruss. See all the finalists for Mexico in their comfort zone here, with their backgrounds /motivations /family and friends.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The first part of the Strongman Champions League 2018 finals in Mexico. The last twelve athletes all pushing their boundaries and testing their limits to take the World title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 11 months and 14 competitions all over the world, it all comes down to the final in this episode. The strongmen must show their best skills and every mistake is expensive, so their concentration must be at the highest possible level. Will Krzysztof manage to take off back or will Dainis maintain his lead?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year 14 athletes from all over the world came to Fefor to compete in 6 cruel events. We'll see typical Viking disciplines on very heavy conditions in land of snow and ice, World records and athletes like the title defender Krzysztof Radzikowski, strongest guys from Holland and Germany and many more

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stop in strongest league of the world is muscle capital, largest number of strong shoulders per capita in the World and of course, the most powerful host in Strongman champions league on the planet. It’s a FIBO - the biggest expo on planet Earth and the second stage of 2019 Strongman champions league, in Cologne, Germany.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On a spectacular beach in Alanya, the MLO Strongman Champions League Turkey was viewed by thousands of spectators over a two day battle. With 12 athletes at the start over 6 cruel events, like Marble Stone Lift, Truckpull and Deadlift cars. And with the comeback of Travis Ortmayer / USA, former stone king and world ranked competitor. Winner of several SCL stages in the past.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Four times Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter competing here in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, and 3 in this episode: The first event, a truckpull of 17.000 kg over 25 meters in max 75 seconds, was a real hard pull Also for the World Champion Truckpull, Holland’s runner-up Kelvin de Ruiter, but watch his amazing technique here.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongest Man of Holland, Alex Moonen and the “Flying Dutchman” Kelvin de Ruiter, competing in Holland against 12 other strongest men in the world. There were 6 events in total, 3 in this second episode; a Viking-press of 150 kg with the current world record holder Luke Herrick. The fifth event, a front hold of 25 kg is loved or hated by the athletes and lastly, the Stones of Strength.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: An unbelievable TANK PULL of 50.000 kg was at the stage of SCL RUSSIA. Never seen this before! Not only a tank pull was done here but also the Viking Press/ Deadlift Max and Log lift reps were spectacular events to see here in Russia. With Mikhail Koklyaev also as event presenter, the former top 3 world strongest man from Russia was there

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this year’s edition on The Balkan Peninsula, we have competing the new talent from Estonia Marko Remlik together with Sebastian Kurek from Poland and yellow leader Kelvin de Ruiter

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland and Aivars Smaukstelis from Latvia are the strongman future of these days. Mateusz is the best man in the World at the moment to defeat. Only 25 years and such a fantastic strongman. They come here only for a win. But there are 12 more Strong athletes in this episode who want the title of Finland as well.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Mateusz Is leading after day 1 (previous episode) with close behind him Aivars Smaukstelis and Zake Muluzi from the UK. All very exciting! 5 events in this episode: Log Lift, Fram Walk, Deadlift, Sack Throw (Weight for Height), Loading medley.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we have a new strong debutant: Oleg Sylka from the Ukraine. He is the new talent, who will stand up against the old champions like ZSydrunas Savickas and Brian Shaw and the Stoltman Brother from the UK. This new talent Oleg is a great character and we will see him flame in the episode in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In Callio is the deepest mine of Europe/ 1500 meter deep, whereas the MLO Strongman Champions League also did 1 event. The Forward Hold, on a 1500 dept/ also a kind of new record/ as it was never done before. Spectacular and new in Strongman sport.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Kelvin de Ruiter is here to defend his SCL World Truck Pull Championships title. But this year, another strong field wants his title. Over 3 different pulls with 3 different trucks, and 14 athletes at the start, it will be difficult for everybody.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL edition Curacao 2019 was a great event, twelve power boys from all over made a great show at the white beaches, and 35 degrees Celsius heat in the Carrabean Islands. Two events were held on Friday at the beach of beautiful resort Sunscape, the other three were held near the world famous floating bridge at Willemstad on Saturday night.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hosted at Meydan Grandstand in Dubai, the Strongman Champions League had some really big names in the list like Mateusz Kieliszkowski from Poland, Brian Shaw from the USA and Krzysztof Radzikowski. In front of the Burj Khalifa the athletes do the deadlift max and 4 other heavy events at another spot in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. The last stage over 2 episodes of the MLO Strongman Champions League, were held in Porto, Portugal. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With new places on the calendar, over 16 stages, broadcasting in over 100 countries and in its 13th year, the MLO Strongman Champions League (SCL) can be seen truly as the biggest strongman league in the world. This competition in Portugal is full of memorable performances and strong results and this is the final!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The spectacular Fefor Arena hosted for the 8th time the Worlds Strongest Viking, part of the SCL World Series. But with the absence of former title holders its anyones game. Again, a very spectacular episode of the Strongman Champions League here in Norway.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, the Titan, former double World champion from Latvia will compete against his fellow countryman and the current World champion - Aivars Smaukstelis. With 8 events over 2 stages the contestants are pushed to their limits in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Dainis Zageris and Aivars Smaukstelis, both from Latvia have a serious, strong battle in the this second and final episode of the SCL Finland 2020. Watch the unbelievable and brute power of these athletes in the last 4 events to crown the winner.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL Germany event takes place in an ancient castle called Die Burg in the heart of Germany. Its here where 5 world record attempts take place across 5 different events with 10 athletes. They will go to the max! See this and much more in the SCL Germany 2020.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Norway is normally all about snow, wind, and cold weather. Our brave athletes are used to compete under conditions few other athletes have competed in, but after COVID delays the competition has been moved from winter to summer bringing in a whole new range of challenges. With an impressive athlete list who will be the winner across 5 cruel events?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Were in sunny Finland for the next stage of a double-bill of SCL action, but this time its a team event. A truly fantastic event with 6000 spectators. Even during COVID times this was exceptional! 8 Strong Teams where fighting for the title over a crazy 9 events.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland, done over 9 cruel events. In this episode the last and final 5 events take place. 8 Strong Teams are fighting for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next set of challenges are set in sunny Esposende in Portugal. With stars such as Travis Ortmayer, Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland, and Ervin Toots from Estonia. While Fabio Silva will defend the honour in his own country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back in Germany, with the world record breakers. We promise you this is going to be amazing. Do not move from that seat, because we are going to see some records smashed today. Over 6 cruel events, you will see who gets crowned of the King Of The Castle!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With the next episode of Strongman Champions League Germany. Its the world record breakers, and in the last show we set two new records. Can more be records be broken before the king of the castle is crowned?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Kokkola in Finland. This city will be the setting for the Lightweight World championship. Out of 24 athletes, only 16 will make it through to the final day, but who will champion each event and who is going to be eliminated?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Its the second day, and the top 16 athletes have made it through to the final round. With another 4 events to go who will get the crown of world champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We’re here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you’re in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they’re going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they’re all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let’s see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We’ve got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan’s Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We’re in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We’ve got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They’re going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other’s strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let’s find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world’s strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we’ll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We’re in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Hello and welcome in Gloucester, UK. The world tour hasn’t been here for what feels like forever. And now for the first time in the Mekka of Strongman, the SCL World series will crown a great Champion with the SCL Title. It will be full with special wooden events, and a great winner! So ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, brace yourselves because I present to you strongman champions league UK.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland the home of Legends Mariusz Pudzianowkski and Krzystof Radzikowski. Who will grab the title here in holiday resort Sopot, on the great Balrtic Sea with 6 events and 12 athlets in the mix!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Sopot, Poland, after 3 events the Polish Strongman Oskar Ziolkowski is Leading. Kelvin, Travis and Aivars are coming up and will try to beat him, but will Oskar take his first title ever?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: it’s been a long time since the world series held a championship here in Sarajevo. Let’s see what test of strength this destination holds for our athletes. And what fantastic athletes are here again in Stage 12 of the SCL World Series. programme.title: Strongman Champions League

Kun hän navigoi petoksessa ja petoksessa, hän tekee yhteistyötä viettelevän arvoituksen kanssa paljastaakseen järkyttäviä totuuksia ja saadakseen takaisin identiteettinsä.

programme.title: Reunalla
programme.desc: Uskallatko ottaa seuraavan askeleen? Vankikarkuri Nick Cassidy ilmestyy yhtäkkiä pilvenpiirtäjän reunukselle New Yorkissa. Aikooko hän hypätä?

programme.title: The Happytime Murders
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthyn tähdittämä räävittömän hillitön komedia Elokuva sijoittuu Los Angelesin laitamille, jossa nuket ja ihmiset elävät rinta rinnan.

programme.title: Meidän gangstereiden kesken
programme.desc: Painija Charlie ja jäätelönmyyjä Sonny ovat huolettomia ja mukavia kavereita, jotka pysyttelevät poissa vaikeuksista. Mutta kun kaupungin ja alamaailman johtaja erehtyy luulemaan heitä pahamaineiseksi tappajakaksikoksi, kaikki muuttuu...

programme.title: Neuvottelija
programme.desc: Poliisille työskentelevä taitava neuvottelija, jota syytetään korruptiosta ja murhasta, yrittää epätoivoisesti todistaa syyttömyytensä ottamalla panttivankeja hallituksen toimistotiloissa saadakseen tarpeeksi aikaa totuuden selvittämiseen.

Outlaws on tarina veljeydestä, uskollisuudesta ja petoksesta rikollisten moottoripyöräkerhojen raa’assa maailmassa. Paddo, Copperheads MC:n kruununperijä, joutuu pettämään kerhon presidentin pelastaakseen veljensä hengen.

programme.title: Savage Salvation
programme.desc: Hiljattain kihlautuneet Shelby John (Jack Huston) ja Ruby Red (Willa Fitzgerald) ovat kääntäneet elämänsä suunnan Peterin (John Malkovich) tuella. Löydettyään Rubyn kuolleena kuistilta Shelby lähtee kostonhimoiselle murharetkelle tuhoamaan vastuussa olevia huumekauppiaita.

programme.title: The Darkest Hour

programme.desc: The capital of Gabon, Libreville offers an off the grid route to the host Emeline. From the scenic trails of Pongara National Park to exciting beach experiences, Libreville comes across as a pleasant surprise. But what’s more exciting is watching a number of sea turtles making their nests and hatching eggs near the beach. Emeline’s quest also leads her to a tête-à-tête with a conservationist where she learns about saving turtles.

programme.title: Boarding Pass

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Flåm is an idyllic town sitting in a spectacular setting at the head of Aurlandsfjorden. Here, Jamie Lowe takes a train ride filled with breathtaking views along Flåmsbana, the world’s steepest railway line. He also takes a cruise to see the stunning UNESCO-listed fjord, Nærøyfjord, and goes on to experience the cuisine and ways of life of the Vikings in Njardarheimr, a Viking village in nearby Gudvangen.

programme.title: World Heritage
programme.desc: The Khajuraho group of temples have awed generations with their architectural brilliance, intricate carvings and their famous erotic sculptures.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Oslo, the 1000-year-old Norwegian capital, is a compact and fun city that offers the perfect experience of contemporary cultural life in Norway. Here, Jamie Lowe visits iconic attractions such as the Nobel Peace Center, as well as more offbeat attractions such as the miniature bottle gallery and Frogner Park, which features 200 statues created by world-famous sculptor, Gustav Vigeland. He also tries the ski jump at nearby Holmenkollen.

programme.title: Kissed By The Sea
programme.desc: Penghu, an archipelago of islands in Taiwan, is a tropical haven infused with oriental flavour. Travel junkie, Alex Drobin discovers this when he enjoys the balance between adventures such as snorkelling and banana boat and exploring the local culture through sights rife with local legends such as a temple dedicated to the goddess of the sea and the Four eye well. He also tries fresh seafood and local Taiwanese dishes such as cactus ice cream.

programme.title: Unwind

programme.title: Off The Grid

programme.title: City Breaks
programme.desc: Frankfurt is the financial capital of the European Union. Kristina discovers that the city has much more to offer than just a good business meeting, as she learns about its history and architecture through its famous sights such as the Kaizerdom Cathedral and the Eltz Castle. She also goes to Rudesheim, where she encounters an amazing collection of data operated music instruments.

programme.title: The Gypsies
programme.desc: After more than a fortnight of travel, Benafsha and Krisann stop at Bhedaghat for some exciting adventures amid its stunning marble cliffs.

programme.title: Boarding Pass
programme.desc: Famous journalist and explorer, Jamie Lowe visits the unofficial capital of the Northern Lights in Norway, Alta, where he encounters the two most exciting experiences the place has to offer: he witnesses the Aurora Borealis and he visits the UNESCO-listed Alta Museum with its rock carvings dating back to 7000 years ago. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: A new student, Duke Devlin, defeats Joey in a game of Duel Monsters, forcing Joey to become his servant. Duke forces Joey to wear a dog costume and humiliates him in public, forcing Yugi to challenge Duke to a duel. However, this will not be a Duel Monsters duel, but a new game named Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: In exchange for Joey’s freedom, Yugi agrees to give up Duel Monsters forever if he loses. Unfamiliar with the rules, Yugi gets off to a rough start. His chances do not improve as Duke reveals that he designed Dungeon Dice Monsters with Pegasus’s aid! Can Yugi learn the new complex rules, much less form a strategy, before he is soundly defeated?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi uses his innate gaming skills to turn the tables on Duke, but Duke has one more rule to mention: All creatures take up territory on the grid-like board. With no room to summon any new monsters, Yugi’s position is helpless!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Duke’s all-powerful Orgoth the Relentless dices Yugi’s entire cadre of monsters into shreds, Yugi only has one turn left before he loses all his heart points! Yugi’s last hope rests in one final dice roll in the thrilling conclusion to Dungeon Dice Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: An arcane fortune teller steals the Millennium Puzzle, and Yugi must defeat him in a duel to win it back! However, this is no ordinary soothsayer; he’s a familiar and formidable foe from Duelist Kingdom… or is he? Can Yugi beat him all alone without the help of his friends or the spirit inside the Puzzle?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The mysterious menace controlling Bandit Keith shatters the Millennium Puzzle into pieces before setting the dueling arena ablaze! Can Yugi put the Millennium Puzzle back together and save the spirit before the entire room is engulfed in flames?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The origin of Duel Monsters is revealed! Using the magic of the Millennium Necklace, Egyptian historian Ishizu Ishtar shows Kaiba how Duel Monsters was played millenniums ago! The ancient games have resurrected in modern times, along with three almighty beasts of unstoppable devastation – the Egyptian God Monsters!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The spirit of the Millennium Puzzle realizes that his memories of ancient Egypt have faded, but Téa is going to help him uncover the mysteries of his past! However, their search is interrupted by the dancing duelist Johnny Steps and his musical monsters of rock!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: To face the future, Yugi must first look into the past! Yugi learns that he was a powerful Pharaoh who saved the world five thousand years ago, and he must now save the world again! Meanwhile, Kaiba tests the hidden powers of his Egyptian God Card Obelisk the Tormentor against the fury of Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey is cornered by a group of sinister Rare Hunters who force Joey into a duel where if Joey loses, the Rare Hunters get his precious Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Though Joey pummels his foes with his mighty monster armada, eliminating life points isn’t the only path to victory…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s time to master new rules and monsters; let the Battle City Tournament commence! In the first duel of the tournament, Yugi challenges the Rare Hunter to win back Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon. However, Yugi’s falling into the same trap that led to Joey’s demise!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi figures out the Rare Hunter’s strategy to summon the almighty Exodia, but it’s too late to stop him! The Rare Hunter already has four pieces of Exodia in his hand, and the fifth and final piece is on top of his deck! How can Yugi stop the unstoppable Exodia?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The psychic duelist Espa Roba defeats Rex Raptor as easy as a chumpasaurus, and Joey’s next on his hit list! What chance does Joey have when Espa Roba has the telepathic ability to read all the cards in Joey’s hand?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey discovers that Espa Roba’s extrasensory perception is a hoax, but he’s not yet free from Espa's mental manipulations! Espa Roba’s Jinzo not only slaughters all of Joey’s monsters, but it grows in power every turn! Joey’s luck has come to an end… or has it?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The magician duelist Arkana transports Yugi to the world’s most lethal dueling arena where the loser gets sent to the Shadow Realm! Yugi must win this duel or he'll lose much more than his Dark Magician!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s Dark Magician versus Dark Magician! However, while Yugi only controls one Dark Magician, Arkana has three residing in his deck! Though outnumbered, Yugi will never give up, as long as he believes in the heart of the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: To counter Arkana’s Dark Magician, Yugi pulls a rabbit out of his hat: Dark Magician Girl! It’s the battle of the sexes to determine the true master of magicians!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The trickster Weevil Underwood spins a web of lies to bait Joey into a lopsided duel! Weevil secretly infests Joey’s deck with a parasite that prevents Joey from summoning strong monsters! Without the support of his most powerful beasts, what chance does Joey have against a monster that even Yugi didn’t dare face at Duelist Kingdom: Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth!?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey swats Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth only to have Weevil let loose the ferocious Insect Queen, the crown jewel of insects that grows in strength for every creepy crawler it cannibalizes! Will Weevil’s royal ravager swarm Joey into submission?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi faces off against another of Marik’s nefarious Rare Hunters – the silent but deadly Strings! Strings stops all of Yugi’s attacks with Revival Jam, a slippery slime that resurrects whenever it’s destroyed! How can Yugi win if he can’t even put a dent in Strings’s life points?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Strings summons one of the most powerful creatures in the history of Duel Monsters... the Egyptian God Monster Slifer the Sky Dragon! What chance does Yugi’s band of mortal monsters have against an Egyptian God?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The spell Infinite Cards allows Strings to hold an unlimited number of cards in his hand, so Strings’s Slifer the Sky Dragon can grow to infinite attack power! Can Yugi discover Slifer’s one fatal flaw before he’s annihilated by tens of thousands of attack points?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey squares off against the sea duelist Mako Tsunami and his bevy of underwater beasts! If Joey wins, he’ll have all six Locator Cards necessary to enter the Battle City Finals, but if he loses, he can kiss the finals goodbye! However, little does Joey realize that he has bigger problems than this duel; the Rare Hunters are closing in on his location…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mako’s oceanic warrior The Legendary Fisherman unleashes a wave of destruction by stealthily destroying Joey’s monsters from the depths of the sea! Joey has to put his skills, training and experience to the ultimate test before he’s all washed out!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Abductions abound! Marik, with the help of Bakura, kidnaps Joey and Téa! To make matters worse, the Rare Hunters also kidnap Mokuba to force Yugi and Kaiba to take on tag team duelists Umbra and Lumis on top of a skyscraper! The losers will be sent plummeting into the Shadow Realm!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Lumis and Umbra systematically dismantle Yugi and Kaiba’s tumultuous teamwork! Can Yugi and Kaiba learn to put their differences aside before they’re sent on a one-way trip into the Shadow Realm?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Kaiba start to exhibit signs of teamwork, but it’s too little too late when Umbra and Lumis summon Masked Beast Des Gardius, a monstrous menace even more powerful than Blue-Eyes White Dragon!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi combines his magnetic monsters into the polar powerhouse Valkyrion the Magna Warrior! However, little does Yugi know that Umbra and Lumis have one final mask to turn Yugi’s monsters against him…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi and Kaiba are on a rescue mission to save their friends! But along the way, all their worries and secrets are revealed as they relive the troubles they’ve faced… and will be facing in the future!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s friend vs. friend as Marik mind controls Joey to duel against Yugi! The loser will be dragged into the ocean to sleep with the fishes! Can Yugi break Joey out of his spell, or will Joey break Yugi?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Though Joey decimates Yugi’s life points, Yugi can’t bring himself to attack his dear friend! Yugi summons Joey’s favorite monster Red-Eyes B. Dragon to try to bring Joey back to his senses. Will seeing his favorite card help Joey break Marik’s spell, or is Yugi’s last ditch effort a lost cause?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi starts to break Marik’s spell over Joey, but he now must duel without the Millennium Puzzle! When Joey draws the card he needs to decimate Yugi’s life points, what chance does Yugi have, especially on his own?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: There’s only one minute left in the duel before the loser is sent plummeting to the depths of the sea! Will these best friends actually send each other to their doom? However, there may be a special savior who just regained her eyesight…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s the battle of the ghouls as Bakura unleashes his army of ghosts against Bonz’s zealous zombies for the right to enter the Battle City Finals! But for whom will the final bell toll when this duel is played in the Shadow Realm…

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: It’s the game of love as Hollywood heartthrob Jean-Claude Magnum challenges Mai to a duel in order to win her hand in marriage! Will Mai succumb to Jean-Claude’s charm, not to mention his cadre of ninja monsters, or will she send him packing back to Tinseltown?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

Suomalaisen sketsiviihteen pieni suuri mies ja suuri pieni mies samassa ohjelmassa. Pääosissa ja käsikirjoittajina toimivat itseoikeutetusti Kari Ketonen ja Ville Myllyrinne. Sivuosissa nähdään Ria Kataja, Pirjo Lonka ja Panu Vauhkonen. Kotimainen komediasarja.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Kausi 16. Jakso 17/20. Kosmiset opettajat. Muinaisastronauttiteorian kulmakiviin kuuluu ajatus, että kehittyneet avaruusolennot sekä opettivat muinaiselle ihmiskunnalle monia teknologisia innovaatiota että jopa puuttuivat ihmiskunnan DNA:n koostumukseen. Amerikkalainen dokumentaarinen sarja.

programme.title: Muinaiset avaruusoliot
programme.desc: Kausi 16. Jakso 18/20. Linda Moulton Howen tutkimukset. Tutkiva journalisti Linda Moulton Howe aloitti erikoisten ilmiöiden tutkinnan jo 1970-luvulla, ja hänestä on vuosikymmenten aikana tullut yksi rajatiedon arvostetuimmista asiantuntijoista. Amerikkalainen dokumentaarinen sarja.

programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari Epsanjassa
programme.desc: Kausi 10. Jakso 7/9. Tervemenoa ja -tuloa, Markku!. Oopperalaulaja Sauli Tiilikainen myy vietnamilaista vellikelloa. Markku pätee työhaastattelussa, mutta kummalla puolella pöytää? Kotimainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Jaksa paremmin
programme.desc: Kausi 15. Jakso 5/14. Kokki ja yrittäjä Akseli Herlevi on tehnyt elämäntaparemontin kiireisen arjen keskellä. Uniasiantuntija Vesa Tuominen vierailee Akselin makuuhuoneessa ja antaa vinkkejä parempaan uneen. Lisäksi Merja Mähkä avaa sijoittamisen perusteita, ja Nina Kuulas testaa skeittausta. Kotimainen lifestyleohjelma.

programme.title: Suomen huutokauppakeisari Epsanjassa
programme.desc: Kausi 10. Jakso 8/9. Saunoja ja sählinkiä. Jalkapallo- ja parvekesauna myytävänä! Aki-ope jakaa elämänohjeita koululla. Ottomaaniklassikkotuunauksen Espanja-versio yllättää. Kotimainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Savotta
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 3/6. Festivaaleja ja konekauppoja. Riitta vierailee FinnMetko konemessuilla. Antti Ruuskanen suunnittelee uuden metsäkoneen hankintaa, mutta saadaanko kauppaa vahvistettua? Metsurit kaavat puita omakotitaloalueella, ja Annastiina käy tarkistamassa, millaisia tuhoja kirjanpainaja on tehnyt metsäpalstalla.

programme.title: Savotta
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 4/6. Mahtuuko toimitusjohtajan säkit peräkärryyn?. Riitta pohtii yrittäjäksi ryhtymistä. Tero suuntaa säkkien hakureissulle Paltamoon. Annastiina suunnittelee Haminan suunnalla leimikkoa. Opiskelijat yrittävät saada vanhaa moottoria käyntiin, mutta ongelmilta ei tietystikään vältytä.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 10/20. Paljon melua omenasta. Kiinalainen pariskunta nostaa äläkän, kun heidän matkatavaroistaan löytyy kiellettyä tavaraa. Postikeskuksessa tutkitaan akvaariovarustelähetystä. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 11/20. Miljoonatiilet. Papua-Uudesta-Guineasta Brisbaneen saapunut lentorahti on ilmoitettu poranteriksi, mutta sen todellinen sisältö on erittäin laitonta ja lähes sadan miljoonan dollarin arvoista. Filippiineiltä Brisbaneen palaava nainen tuo mukanaan eläviä ja elottomia bioturvallisuusuhkia. Tupakkatuotteiden tullimaksujen väistely tulee kalliiksi neljälle nuorelle miehelle Melbournessa. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Australian rajalla
programme.desc: Kausi 17. Jakso 12/20. Kiinalainen katoamistemppu. Sydneyn lentoasemalle saapuva nepalilaismies tekeytyy turistiksi, mutta hänen todelliset aikeensa vaikuttavat olevan jotain muuta. Samalle lentoasemalle saapuu kaksi kiinalaista naista, joista toinen järjestää erikoisen tempauksen jouduttuaan vaikeuksiin. Sydneyn kansainvälisessä postikeskuksessa tutkitaan kahta epäilyttävää pakettia. Australialainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Michelin-kokkien keittiöissä
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 1/10. Alex Dilling. Lontoolaisen Hotel Café Royalin keittiömestari Alex Dilling esittelee kaksi nimikkoannostaan, joista toinen nojaa ranskalaiseen ja toinen hieman yllättäen amerikkalaiseen keittiöön. Kanadalainen ruokareality.

programme.title: Michelin-kokkien keittiöissä
programme.desc: Kausi 1. Jakso 2/10. Kirk Westaway. Singaporessa toimiva keittiömestari Kirk Westaway tekee brittiläistyylistä ruokaa modernilla otteella. Singaporelaisittain eksoottinen linja on saanut osakseen paljon ihailua sekä kaksi Michelin-tähteä. Kanadalainen ruokareality.

programme.title: Maailman salatuimmat hotellit
programme.desc: Kausi 2. Jakso 3/6. Yksinäisyyden luksusta. Entisaikojen vankilassa Cornwallissa majoitutaan nykyään vapaaehtoisesti, koska paikka toimii luksushotellina. Nykyihmiselle yksinäisyys on luksusta, ja siitä voi nauttia Walesin maaseudulla järven rannalla tai majakkasaarella Ruotsissa. Eteläafrikkalaisessa vuoristohotellissa ja sademetsän kätköissä Australiassa voi kokea olevansa osa luontoa. Englantilainen lifestyleohjelma.

programme.title: Maailman salatuimmat hotellit
programme.desc: Kausi 2. Jakso 4/6. Elämyksiä etsimässä. Nykymatkailijat hakevat lomakohteiltaan elämyksiä. Niitä tarjoavat majakkahotelli Kanariansaarilla, moderni mestariteos Meksikossa ja kelluva pakopaikka Englannin maaseudulla. Historiallisia elämyksiä voi hakea keskiaikaisesta majatalosta Ryessa tai vanhasta loistohotellista Alpeilla. Englantilainen lifestyleohjelma.

programme.title: Panttilainaamo
programme.desc: Kausi 24. Jakso 63/67. Tykitystä. Tänään tarjolla olisi pari italialaisia pistooleja ja Ming-dynastian aikainen käsikanuuna. Mutta kestävätkö ne lähempää tarkastelua? Rick saa myös tilaisuuden tutustua kokoelmaan Paul Newmanin autoja. Amerikkalainen realitysarja.

programme.title: Panttilainaamo
programme.desc: Kausi 24. Jakso 64/67. Siksakkia. Tänään taikurin illuusio saa Chumin mutkalle, kallis kaulakoru Coreyn sanattomaksi ja Rickin klassikkoelokuvan innoittama asu kaikki pidättelemään naurua. Ohessa toki ehditään myös käydä kauppaa mielenkiintoisilla esineillä. Amerikkalainen realitysarja.

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: (Quantum of Solace/Britannia-USA 2008). Daniel Craig palaa James Bondin rooliin seikkailussa, joka on suoraa jatkoa Casino Royale -elokuvan tapahtumille. Bond tapaa salaperäisen Camillen (Olga Kurylenko), joka johdattaa hänet Quantum-järjestöä johtavan vaarallisen liikemiehen Dominic Greenen (Mathieu Amalric) jäljille. Etelä-Amerikassa kuvioihin astuu myös upea MI6-agentti Strawberry Fields (Gemma Arterton), ja ennen pitkää yllättävät käänteet palastavat luonnonvarojen häikäilemättömään hallintaan liittyvän salaliiton. Alicia Keysin ja Jack Whiten esittämä tunnuskappale Another Way to Die on kaikkien aikojen ensimmäinen duettona esitetty Bond-kappale. Elokuvan käsikirjoituksesta vastaa myös Casino Royalen kirjoittanut kolmikko, johon kuuluu Oscar-voittaja Paul Haggis (Crash, Million Dollar Baby). Ohjaaja Marc Forster muistetaan myös menestyksistä Aidosti outoa ja Monster's Ball. Pääosissa: Daniel Craig, Olga Kurylenko, Mathieu Amalric, Giancarlo Giannini, Gemma Arterton, Judi Dench, Jeffrey Wright. Ohjaus: Marc Forster.

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Draamatassut: Tässä Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol -jaksossa Pol väistää potkun tukehtuvalta tammalta. Tri Brenda kiirehtii ontuvan lehmän luo. Tri Lisa hoitaa nuorta härkää. Klinikalla eläinlääkärit lähes hukkuvat koiriin: chihuahualla on murtunut jalka, tiine koira on aivan viimeisillään ja dobermannilla on outoja kyhmyjä kasvoissa. Eläinlääkärit hoitavat niin muuleja kuin musteja.

programme.title: Uskomaton eläinlääkäri Pol
programme.desc: Täältä tulee marsu: PVS:n eläinlääkärit hoitavat kesäisiä vaivoja, kuten marsun paisetta ja poroa, jolla on outo rupi. Hurjat haavat saanut saksanpaimenkoira ja koiranpentu, jolla on silmävamma, tarvitsevat tri Nicolen taitoja. Tri Pol hoitaa sairasta lehmää ja auton alle jäänyttä kissaa. Kymmenelle ihanalle pennulle tehdään terveystarkastus ja minihevonen tarvitsee pikaista apua.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: The Americas and Australia: Ihmiset ovat muinaisista ajoista lähtien olleet monimutkaisessa suhteessa käärmeisiin. Amerikan ja Australian monipuolisissa elinympäristöissä elää myrkyllisiä kyykäärmeitä ja voimakkaita kuristajakäärmeitä, jotka ovat kukin kehittyneet täyttämään oman ekologisen lokeronsa. Amerikassa yli 30 käärmelajia hillitsee jyrsijöiden määrää ja ylläpitää ekosysteemejä. Samaan aikaan Australian koralliriutat kätkevät vieläkin tappavampia merikäärmeitä ja vaikeasti havaittavia, erittäin myrkyllisiä rannikkotaipaaneja. Rehevästä metsästä aavikon hiekkaan ja meren syvyyksiin – nämä mantereet kätkevät salaisen maailman, jossa elää joitakin kaikkein tappavimpia, kiehtovimpia ja salaperäisimpiä käärmeitä.

programme.title: The Hidden World of Snakes
programme.desc: Africa: Afrikan laajoilla alueilla on hämmästyttävä valikoima elinympäristöjä, joissa elää myrkyllisiä käärmeitä ja ikonisia kuristajakäärmeitä, jotka ovat kaikki sopeutuneet täydellisesti omaan elinympäristöönsä. Etelä-Afrikan sydämessä pahamaineinen musta mamba herättää pelkoa elefanttiperheessä ennen kuin se ryhtyy jännittävään taisteluun itselleen sopivan parin saamiseksi. Kobrat taistelevat keskenään ja jopa omien lajitoveriensa kanssa, esitellen nopeutta ja voimaa symboloivia huppuja. Egyptin kuumassa ja pölyisessä maastossa selviytyvät ovelat kyykärmeet, jotka hallitsevat ympäristöään – eivät koon tai voiman, vaan taitavan naamioitumisen ja tarkasti suunnatun myrkkynsä ansiosta.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsayn makuseikkailut
programme.desc: Upeat Smoky Mountains -vuoret: Gordon Ramsay joutuu äärirajoille Smoky Mountains -vuorilla, kun hän laskeutuu vaarallista vesiputousta, menee kajakilla kuohuvia koskia ja matkaa syvälle metsään hakemaan vuoristoalueen maukkaimpia aineksia.

programme.title: Will Smith maailman äärissä
programme.desc: Etelänapa: Will kamppailee etelänavan jäätävässä tuulessa, jossa lämpötila voi laskea alle -70 °C. Hän hiihtää, vaeltaa ja kiipeää jättimäisten jääkenttien ja kallioiden yli maailman parhaiden napaurheilijoiden joukkoon kuuluvan Richard Parksin tuella. Yhdellä planeetan eristäytyneimmistä tutkimusasemista tutkijat ottavat näytteitä syvältä pinnan alta ja tekevät uskomattomia uhrauksia tutkimuksensa eteen.

programme.title: Will Smith maailman äärissä
programme.desc: Amazonin tappavat olennot: Hämähäkkejä pelkäävä Will lähtee Ecuadorin Amazonille etsimään tappavia olentoja. Professori Bryan Fryn ja paikallisen vuorikiipeilijän Carla Perezin kanssa hän laskeutuu 60 metriä syvälle luolaverkostoon, joka tunnetaan ”maan kohtuna”. Uusimman tekniikan avulla he ottavat talteen jättitarantulan myrkkyä, joka voi olla avain miljoonien ihmisten hengen pelastamiseen.

programme.title: Jimmy Chin ja vaaran viehätys
programme.desc: Vaaralliset vedet: Kajakkilegendat Ben Stookesberry ja Chris Korbuic ovat laskeneet yhdessä satoja kertoja maailman vaarallisimmista koskista. Yksi joki on kuitenkin jättänyt heihin merkkinsä. Kongon Lukuga-joen rauhallisissa vesissä piileskelee yksi maailman suurimmista krokotiilikeskittymistä. Vuonna 2010 he meloivat sitä pitkin opettajansa Hendri Coetzeen kanssa. Silloin he näkivät hänet viimeisen kerran.

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: NG Wild: Syvyyksien oudot otukset: Pääjalkaiset ovat muodonmuuttajia, joilla on kolme sydäntä, sinistä verta ja reikiä aivoissaan. Ne saattavat vaikuttaa toisesta galaksista tulleilta olennoilta, mutta nämä mustekalat, kalmarit ja seepiat ovat planeetan älykkäimpiä olentoja. Tutkimme merten pimeimmissä syvyyksissä elävien ihmeellisten olentojen salaperäistä maailmaa.

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: Harvinaisten kissojen taidot: Harvinaiset villikissat osoittavat erikoislaatuisia selviytymiskykyjä. Tuhansien vuosien aikana jokainen laji on kehittänyt ainutlaatuisia sopeutumiskeinoja sopiakseen ympäristöönsä. Arokissa sulautuu Kiinan kivisille aroille, musta pantteri metsästää Intian metsien varjoissa ja lumileopardi kiipeilee jäisillä Himalajan huipuilla.

programme.title: Junamatkat ylhäältä päin
programme.desc: Copper Canyonin rautatie: El Chepe kulkee Creelin vuoristokaupungista alkaen upean Copper Canyonin läpi, jossa asuu eristäytynyt raramuri-kansa. Liitymme insinöörien seuraan tällä vuoristoisella rautatiellä, jonka rakentaminen kesti 100 vuotta. He pitävät sen turvassa kiviltä, äkillisiltä tulvilta ja jopa hurrikaaneilta. Matka päättyy Los Mochisiin Sinaloan osavaltiossa, joka on portti Tyynellemerelle.

programme.title: Lentoturmatutkinta
programme.desc: Kerrostalokatastrofi. Vuonna 1992 lento 1862 Amsterdamista Tel Aviviin päättyi järkyttävin seurauksin. Tutkijat löysivät vian, joka uhkasi kaikkia 747-koneita.

programme.title: Pohjolan villi luonto
programme.desc: Norjan viikinkirannikko: Norjan viikinkirannikolla on valtavia vuonoja, korkeita vuoria ja huimapäisiä tutkijoita, jotka yhdistävät muinaiset kulttuurit nykyajan erämaihin.

programme.title: Pohjolan villi luonto
programme.desc: Norjan jylhä vuoristo: Skandien vuoret Norjassa ja Ruotsissa ovat lumipeitteisiä, tuulisia, karuja ja kesyttämättömiä. Tundra luo elinympäristön muinaisille lajeille, kuten myskihärille, naaleille ja taruistakin tutuille poroille.

programme.title: Pohjolan villi luonto
programme.desc: Pohjolan villi luonto paljastaa laajat, muinaisten perinteiden jäiset erämaat, joissa elää ainutlaatuisia, rankkoja talvia vastaan taistelevia eläimiä.

programme.title: Pohjolan villi luonto
programme.desc: Suomen villit vesistöt: Suomen pohjoisosista asti villit viikinkijoet inspiroivat niin tutkijoita kuin uskaliaita luistelijoita ja alastomia avantouimareitakin.

programme.title: Pohjolan villi luonto
programme.desc: Lapin kesyttömät eläimet: Taigan olennot elävät Lapin muinaisissa metsissä. Tämä syyskausi todella testaa niiden selviytymiskykyjä.

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: Villi Lappi: Runollinen katsaus mielenkiintoisiin villeihin eläimiin, jotka pitävät Lappia kotinaan.

programme.title: Alamaailma Oy
programme.desc: Las Vegasin puhallus: Hämärä Las Vegas. Viranomaisten on oltava valppaina salakuljettajien raaistuvassa maailmassa, kun rikolliset alkavat päästä perille hallituksen taktiikoista. National Geographic Channel.

programme.title: Legendaarinen Tsingis-kaani
programme.desc: Temujin – poika, josta tuli kaani: Avausjaksossa syvennytään Tšingis-kaanin elämän alkuvaiheisiin. Tšingis-kaanin varhaisvuodet olivat täynnä dramaattisia kamppailuja, kuten hänen perheensä putoaminen vallasta, selviytymistaistelu kilpailevia heimoja vastaan ja ensimmäisiä liittolaisuuksia nuorena soturina, joka oli päättänyt pelastaa siepatun vaimonsa Borten.

programme.title: Rooman kadonneet aarteet
programme.desc: Pompejin unohdetut uhrit: Pompeji oli kukoistava kaupunki Italian etelärannikolla, kunnes se tuhoutui äkillisesti vuonna 79 jKr. Läheisen tulivuoren, Vesuviuksen, purkaus peitti kaupungin miljoonilla tonneilla tuhkaa ja roskia. Nyt arkeologit kaivavat esiin tämän idyllisen roomalaiskaupungin pimeää puolta paljastamalla orjuutetun henkilön huoneen.

programme.title: No title
programme.desc: Pohjois-Korea: Seuraava johtaja: Kun Pohjois-Korean johtaja Kim Jong-un katosi kolmeksi viikoksi, huhut siitä, että hän oli loukkaantunut tai kuollut, alkoivat kiiriä. Ilman suunnitelmaa seuraajasta epävakaus eristetyssä, ydinaseita omistavassa diktatuurissa voi vaikuttaa koko maailmaan. Kolme sukupolvea on pitänyt valtaa yli seitsemän vuosikymmenen ajan. Jos nykyiselle johtajalle tapahtuisi jotain, kuka olisi seuraava jonossa?

programme.title: Autojen ensiapu
programme.desc: Lootuksen kukka. Tim ja Fuzz matkustavat ympäri Britanniaa etsimässä parhaat päivänsä nähneitä autoja ja omistajia, jotka tarvitsevat apua niiden kunnostamisessa.

programme.title: Kokeile tai kuole
programme.desc: Kokeile tai kuole

programme.title: Salakuljettajat satimeen

Ovatko tarjoilut kyläläisten mieleen? Vaikeiden hyvästien aika lähestyy, ja Camilla sanoo rakkailleen näkemiin. Mutta missä Camilla oikeastaan tuntee olevansa kotona? Onko koti välttämättä aina jokin konkreettinen paikka? (U)

programme.title: Talot huokuvat historiaa
programme.desc: Kausi 6, 5/8. Anette asuu kolmen lapsensa kanssa Gotlannissa vanhassa 1700-luvun talossa. Talo oli ollut vuosia tyhjillään, ja muutto sinne edellytti monenlaista remonttia. Kunnostustöitä tehdessään Anette löysi lattialankkujen alta pinkan tunteellisia kirjeitä, joiden lähettäjä on ollut Amerikkaan muuttanut mies. Kotona häntä oli odottanut oma rakas ja tytär. Anette haluaa tietää, keitä he olivat ja kuinka heidän kävi. Saivatko he toisensa? Vastauksia etsiessään antiikkiesineiden tuntija Rickard Thunér törmää yllätyksiin ja käänteisiin. Yhdessä rakennustutkija Erika Åbergin kanssa perhe uusii talon julkisivun käyttämällä perinteistä gotlantilaista kalkkia. (U)

programme.title: Afrika von oben: Sambia
programme.desc: Ein Flug über den Binnenstaat Sambia führt ins Herz des südlichen Afrikas. Das Land ist von mächtigen Flüssen durchzogen. Die Reise führt im Osten entlang des Sambesi über die üppigen Feuchtgebiete im Norden und erreicht schließlich das Luangwa-Tal im Osten. Die Victoriafälle an der Grenze zu Simbabwe sind einer der größten Wasserfälle der Erde.

programme.title: Afrika von oben: Uganda
programme.desc: Eine Reise aus der Luft über Uganda zeigt spektakuläre Landschaften: die gletscherbedeckten Ruwenzori-Berge, urzeitliche Regenwälder und Kraterseen.

programme.title: Afrika von oben: Mosambik
programme.desc: Eine Reise aus der Luft über Mosambik zeigt vielfältige Naturräume: von den südlichen Savannenebenen entlang der Küste des Indischen Ozeans über Bergregenwälder hinweg bis zum Sambesi-Delta. Einsame Strände säumen unberührte Meeresparadiese. Hier tummeln sich Große Tümmler, und farbenfrohe Korallenriffe beherbergen eine riesige Artenvielfalt. Das Verschmelzen afrikanischer, arabischer und europäischer Traditionen macht Mosambik zu einem der rätselhaftesten Länder Afrikas.

programme.title: Afrika von oben: Südafrika
programme.desc: Eine erstaunliche Reise führt aus der Luft über das südlichste Land des Kontinents: Südafrika. Zu entdecken sind spektakuläre Küsten, wo es im Meer von Leben nur so wimmelt, und pulsierende Städte voller Leben. Südafrika vereint unterschiedlichste Naturräume. Es ist ein wildes Land, in dem die Menschen für den Erhalt ihrer kostbaren Naturschätze kämpfen.

programme.title: Südafrikas Westen von oben
programme.desc: Südafrikas Westen ist dank Tafelberg, Kapstadt und der schönen Garden Route weltweit bekannt. Im Landesinneren wird edler Wein produziert, und an den Küsten leben Wale, Robben und Pinguine.

programme.title: Südafrikas Osten von oben
programme.desc: Vom Indischen Ozean bis in die über 3000 Meter hohen Drakensberge bietet Südafrika vielfältige Landschaften, weite Strände und moderne Millionenstädte mit einer bewegten Geschichte.

Das Thema: Der finnische Rapper Signmark - seine letzte Tour? Beitrag von Anke Klingemann und Stefan Brainbauer

programme.desc: Die Piusbruderschaft, 1970 von Erzbischof Marcel Lefebvre gegründet, sieht die katholische Kirche auf einem Irrweg des Modernismus und lehnt die Reformen des Zweiten Vatikanischen Konzils als zeitgeistige Verwässerung des katholischen Glaubens ab.

programme.title: 37°Leben
programme.desc: Wie kommt man zurück ins Leben mit einer Depression? Mit einer Psychose? Sandrine und Sara berichten über ihre Erfahrungen und darüber, was ihnen geholfen hat.

programme.title: Die Elefanten der Victoriafälle
programme.desc: Die Victoriafälle gehören zu den spektakulärsten Naturwundern Afrikas. Aber nicht nur Menschen zieht es dorthin – auch viele Wildtiere, denn hier können sie ihren Durst löschen.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne (1/6)
programme.desc: Ein einsamer Inselberg inmitten der Savanne entpuppt sich als genialer Rückzugsort für große und kleine Raubtiere. Mit Ausblick auf die Weiten der Serengeti ist der Granitfels heiß umkämpft. Vor allem Paviane und ein Löwenrudel konkurrieren um die Festung. Als am Himmel Rauchwolken aufziehen, gerät das Leben aller Tiere in Gefahr ...

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne (2/6)
programme.desc: Die Savanne steht in Flammen, und die Tiere kämpfen ums Überleben. Den meisten bleibt nur die Flucht. Nach dem Feuer müssen alle Tierfamilien Wege finden, um sich in der verkohlten Landschaft mit ausreichend Wasser und Nahrung zu versorgen, bis der nächste Regen kommt.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne (3/6)
programme.desc: Das Land erholt sich nach dem Feuer, der Fluss führt reichlich Wasser. Während die Löwenjungen schutzlos den Gefahren der Savanne ausgesetzt sind, muss auch das Nilpferdbaby im Fluss das Überleben lernen. Wird die Löwin ihre Jungen lebend finden, nachdem sie von einer wütenden Elefantenherde in die Luft geschleudert wurden?

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne (4/6)
programme.desc: Die Löwen machen sich breit auf dem Inselberg und beanspruchen das Terrain. Es ist Zeit für die Paviane, sich in Sicherheit zu bringen. Auch die Flussbewohner müssen um Lebensraum kämpfen und ihre Jungen schützen. Für Löwen und Geparden kommt mit der Wanderung der Gnus die Chance auf eine Mahlzeit. Doch auch bei der Masse der Tiere braucht es Jagdgeschick, um Beute zu machen.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne (5/6)
programme.desc: Als die Trockenzeit einsetzt, schwindet der See und das Wasser für die Tiere wird knapp. An den Wasserstellen treffen alle zusammen: Flusspferde, Krokodile, Zebras und Flamingos. Die Konkurrenz um Futter nimmt zu, die Hyänen machen den Geparden die Beute streitig. Tausende von Zebras und Gnus machen sich auf den Weg auf der Suche nach grünem Land. Und auch am Fluss gibt es Gerangel.

programme.title: Serengeti - Wilde Geschichten aus der Savanne (6/6)
programme.desc: Die Trockenzeit bringt drückende Hitze. Dicht gedrängt stecken Flusspferde im Schlammloch gefangen. Selbst die Wasserlöcher der Elefanten sind ausgetrocknet. Doch es liegt was in der Luft: Wolken kündigen den Beginn der Regenzeit an. Mit dem Regen wird das Land wieder grün und üppig, die Herden kehren zurück. Jetzt gilt es für die Elterntiere, den Nachwuchs vor Jägern zu schützen.

programme.title: NANO: Liebe und Bindung
programme.desc: Von der Geburt bis ins hohe Alter ist die Bindung zu anderen Menschen ein fundamentales Element des Lebens. Welchen Einfluss hat die Digitalisierung auf dieses Grundbedürfnis?

programme.title: heute
programme.desc: Die heute ist eine Nachrichtensendung des ZDF mit aktuellen Meldungen des Tages aus den Bereichen Politik, Wirtschaft, Wissenschaft, Kultur, Gesellschaft, Sport und Wetter. Die Sendung informiert kompakt und verständlich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse im In- und Ausland und ordnet diese journalistisch ein. Ergänzt wird sie durch Hintergrundberichte, Live-Schalten und Korrespondentenbeiträge. Durch ihre klare Struktur und verlässliche Berichterstattung gehört sie zu den festen Informationsformaten im deutschen Fernsehen und bietet täglich einen schnellen Überblick über das aktuelle Geschehen.
